reference.title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media

accept_tolerances.note: Panel-read anchors; tolerances per house rule (stated, not hidden). Sign/trend asserts are hard.

equations.pcGNLSE: Eq. (10): sGy -> |sgy| in Raman-shift term; sigma -> |sigma| in SS-Raman dissipative term

model.raman: first-order moment form (paper Eq. 8), TR/T0 = tau_R
model.orbital: single field, comoving frame; beta1 omitted

dark_cases.name: I

anchors.eta: drifts to ~ -100 over xi = 10 (Fig. 4d; GVD-led, then TOD)
anchors.M: constant M (M = M_core at Omega(0) = 0), positive
anchors.chirp: opposite sign to the delay, rapid rise near xi ~ 1 (GVD)

dark_cases.P0_note: derived from E0 = 2 P0 Bd^2 rho (S48), Table II E0

dark_cases.name: II

anchors.delay_pc: negative, larger magnitude than case I (Fig. 5d)
anchors.M_gnlse: negative (Raman-abatic, nonsense for a Raman-driven path)

dark_cases.P0_note: derived from E0 = 2 P0 Bd^2 rho (S48), Table II E0

dark_cases.name: III

anchors.source: paper Figs. 6/7 (recorded from the pages; qualitative)
anchors.pc: SS-induced progressive spectral dispersion; GNLS waveform near-constant
anchors.energy: structural sign split kept hard (paper: pc decays? endpoint values page-level; exact panel numbers p-09 pending a fresh read)

dark_cases.P0_note: derived from E0 = 2 P0 Bd^2 rho (S48), Table II E0

numerics.integrator: RK4IP split-step (dimensionless, reproduction-local; the paper uses an adaptive SSFM)
caveats: Dark CW background integrated on a finite periodic window (paper's own impulse-window choice not stated); dark asserts are trend/sign-based plus the panel anchors quoted.

Bright moment ODEs (paper Eqs. 18-23 == S36) implemented as-S35-printed; Eq. S20's Delta_TOD leading term is ambiguous in the PDF text layer (3*d*Omega^2 implemented); chirp-equation remainder validated against the direct simulation instead of forced.

2026-09-30 transcription fix: the paper's Table II fixes E0 = 1 (I/II: rho0 = 1; III: rho0 = 2) with Bd = 0.9; the S48 constraint E = 2 P0 Bd^2 rho then REQUIRES P0 = E0/(2 Bd^2 rho0) = 0.6173 (I/II) and 0.3086 (III). The v1 decks hardcoded P0 = 1.0, which broke the E anchor (E(0) = 1.62 vs the paper's 1.0) and doubled the Kerr/MI scale; dark-case P0 now derived from E0/2*Bd^2*rho0.
